# Copilot Instructions for 0xgiwa Repository

## Repository Overview
This is the 0xgiwa repository. When making changes to this repository, follow these guidelines.

## General Coding Practices
- Write clear, maintainable code with descriptive variable and function names
- Follow consistent code style and formatting conventions
- Add comments for complex logic or non-obvious implementations
- Keep functions and methods focused on a single responsibility

## Documentation
- Update README.md when adding new features or making significant changes
- Include inline documentation for public APIs and complex functions
- Use clear commit messages that describe the purpose of changes

## Testing
- Write tests for new features and bug fixes when applicable
- Ensure existing tests pass before submitting changes
- Follow existing test patterns and conventions in the repository

## Security
- Never commit sensitive data like API keys, passwords, or tokens
- Validate and sanitize user inputs
- Follow secure coding practices and be mindful of common vulnerabilities

## Pull Requests
- Keep changes focused and atomic
- Provide clear descriptions of what changed and why
- Reference related issues in PR descriptions
